description: The valid node:crypto JWS over header {"alg":"Ed25519"} (copied from jws-oracle/ed25519-compact-verify.json) verified with the RFC 8037 A.2 public key (no JWK alg) and allow-list ["EdDSA"]: EdDSA and Ed25519 (RFC 9864) are separate allow-list entries, so Ed25519 is not allowed (RFC 8725 §3.1; ADR 0026 §2 step 7)
